service_description: Preparation and filing of Annual Return (NAR1), including roll-forward of company particulars and e-filing with the Companies Registry
Preparation and filing of Employer's Return (BIR56A + IR56B forms) for all employees, including payroll data reconciliation
Preparation of audited-accounts-based Profits Tax Return (BIR51), tax computation and filing with IRD
Preparation and filing of Individual Tax Return (BIR60) for directors, including salaries tax computation and claim of allowances
Review of Notice of Assessment, verification against filed return, and payment reminder service
